acceptance: G1 to G3 each have a dated owner decision quoted in context before the corresponding engine is touched.

For each engine implemented: after apply_rf1 on update set 1 at SF0.01, ORDERS and LINEITEM row counts and per-column checksums equal those from the VALUES path on an identical starting table (evidence pasted in context; live run, not a mock).
For each engine: a timer-boundary unit test shows file transfer or formatting, the COPY or LOAD statement and BEGIN/COMMIT are inside the RF1 timer, and only relocation is before it.

RF1 duration on SF1 for each implemented engine is recorded next to the VALUES path measured in the same session; if the native path is not faster, record the numbers and revert that engine to the fallback.
An engine without owner approval or without a passing live run is explicitly left on the fallback and named as such in the doc row and in a closing context note.
context: Origin: 2026-11-03 root-cause analysis of TPC-H RF1 timing (5 whys) and its adversarial review. Spec clauses cited here were read from the published PDFs at the links on 2026-11-03; re-read them rather than trusting this text.
description:
Extend the RF1 ingest capability added by perf-tpch-rf1-bulk-load-20261031 to the two remaining refresh-capable engines that still use the VALUES fallback: Snowflake (supports_refresh_functions = True in benchbox/platforms/snowflake.py) and SingleStore (benchbox/platforms/singlestore.py).

Decision gates (owner):
G1. Owner approves live-cloud spend for Snowflake runs in this task and names the account or credentials source. Without G1, do not run any Snowflake command; ship nothing for Snowflake.
G2. Relocation and formatting on Snowflake. Proposed: PUT with AUTO_COMPRESS=FALSE before the timer (relocation only), then COPY INTO with ON_ERROR=ABORT_STATEMENT inside the timer. Whether default auto-compression counts as 'data formatting' under TPC-H 5.3.7.10 is unresolved; the owner decides, and the choice is recorded in the doc row. Do not reuse the adapter's load_data (it truncates and uses ON_ERROR='CONTINUE').
G3. SingleStore: confirm LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE is permitted on the target (local_infile enabled) before relying on it; if it is not, record that and leave SingleStore on the fallback.

Spec: TPC-H 3.0.1 clause 5.3.7.10; only relocation may precede the timer.

Guardrails: Guardrails for all code work: work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone. No explanatory comments or docstrings in source (make comment-policy-check). Durations use benchbox.utils.clock.mono_time()/elapsed_seconds(). Add a changelog.d/ fragment. Cited line numbers are orientation only: re-read the named symbols, docs and spec clauses before editing and treat a mismatch as a reason to stop and update this item. No live-cloud runs without owner approval; heavy runs only through make heavy-run or a lock-taking entry point. Green focused tests are not release certification. A partial result is acceptable: each engine closes independently; an engine without proof stays on the VALUES fallback and is listed as such in docs/internal/tpc-measured-intervals.md.
